title: Record the billing model in docs/BILLING.md and the billing feature files
description:
Specs first. Before any billing code, the model in the epic becomes a reviewed document and a set of feature files that later stories implement against.

Done looks like: `docs/BILLING.md` describing profiles, plan catalog, billing lines, the two modes, the invoice ledger (invoices, payments, allocations, journal), the Stripe boundary and the operator permission, with a section listing the open questions and their status; README and ARCHITECTURE link it; SECURITY.md gains a "Billing" section (no card data, billing contact data retention, who may write, Stripe parameters). Feature files: `features/billing-profile.feature`, `features/billing-lines.feature`, `features/billing-ledger.feature`, `features/billing-stripe.feature`, `features/billing-operator-ui.feature`, `features/billing-portal.feature`, each with the scenarios named in the corresponding story. Scenarios use made-up names and `.invalid` addresses only.

Data touched: documentation and feature files only. No runtime, IAM or Stripe change.

Specs: the feature files are the deliverable; `npm run lint` and the docs link check pass.
